title: FBI Photo B6
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured from a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The displayed timestamp (12/31/99) is a system default and does not reflect the actual date of the observation, which was late 2025.
The original image was redacted before submission to AARO, meaning potentially significant details have been removed.
No accompanying mission report was provided, so operational context is missing.
The OCR-extracted text from the image is heavily garbled, with most HUD overlay data unreadable.
This is a single still image from a single source with no corroborating evidence provided.
The narrative description from war.gov explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment.

verifiable_claims.claim: The displayed date of 12/31/99 is incorrect due to system date/time not being set
